shortDefinition.en: The appearance of out-of-focus background structure, influenced by distances, aperture, lens rendering, and framing.
shortDefinition.zh-cn: 离焦背景结构的外观，受距离、光圈、镜头呈现和取景影响。

en: Two equal depth-of-field calculations do not guarantee identical background blur.
zh-cn: 两个相同的景深计算结果不保证背景虚化相同。

example.en: Moving the background farther away can change blur even when the subject focus range is similar.
example.zh-cn: 即使主体清晰范围相近，让背景更远也能改变虚化。

sources.title: Depth of Field — Cambridge in Colour
sources.locator: Background distance and depth of field
sources.supports: Background distance and acceptable-focus range are distinct parts of image appearance.
